title: My notes disapeared
body:
Hello,
I had dozens of notes in the Apple Notes app on my iPad. Suddenly, all of them disappeared and the Notes app itself was uninstalled without me doing it.

I checked my iCloud account – Notes sync was enabled, and iCloud Backup was also turned on, but my notes are not showing in iCloud.com or on my device.

I also see the Recently Deleted folder, but it is empty. I tried reinstalling the Notes app and restarting the device, but the notes did not come back.

Can you please check if there is any way to recover my notes from iCloud or from a server-side archive, even though the Recently Deleted folder is empty?

Thank you for your help.

title: Mistakes that should be fixed
body:
This app is good and needed, but there are one or two things that
the developers should fix. I use this app on my iPad Air and need it for school. This is now the fourth time the app has gone wrong. I've been making homework as usual, and when I was done, I didn't turn the iPad off or shut down the app. I just kept it open and then clicked on a new note to write. But when I came back, there was only half of it and I couldn't do anything about it, and my long work was gone in a second. I mean, if it happened once, I wouldn't write it here, some mistakes can happen I understand that, but four times in three weeks? That's too much. Please fix it, it is unpleasant and I'm sure I'm not the only one who's experienced that.
Also, the notes seem to be endless, but from a certain point they get stuck, it takes about 2 seconds for what I wrote to appear. So they are not endless, they just look like they are... I think that if they weren't endless, it would be so much better or fix the jamming, it's horrible.
